title: 知识 embedding 总 deadline 与取消传播
changes: Added DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DEADLINE_MS (120s) as one total operation budget for query + document batches.
The per-batch 30s ceiling is clamped to the remaining total budget.
The batch loop checks the remaining budget before every batch and never starts a request after expiry.
Added KnowledgeEmbeddingDeadlineError with code, deadlineMs, completedBatches and totalBatches; partial vectors are never returned.
knowledge-api creates the provider with KNOWLEDGE_EMBEDDING_DEADLINE_MS (default 120s) for the semantic answer path; source-set reports semanticLane=error and keeps lexical ordering on failure.
EMB-1 worst case for 100 texts drops from 390000ms to 120000ms.
limitations: Network timing is simulated with a fake clock; no live SiliconFlow request was made.
Deadline cancellation is implemented as one budget per provider instance; callers must create a fresh provider per operation.
notChanged: No product lock, default value or release status changed.

candidate.note: Tests and static checks ran on the clean parent tree; this evidence file is part of the same branch commit.
